cannot apply the environment profile's permitted sets to the compiled control sets: the
environment profile's permitted region set is present but empty, which permits no region
at all (from environment-profile:clinical-genomics-l3). omit the permitted.regions field
to add no boundary on that axis, or list at least one member. An empty allowlist is not
a strict policy but a DENY-ALL: it denies every call in the account, including the ones
automat's own baseline makes, and nothing about the document says so. Reaching this
point means the profile was not validated before it was compiled — the schema and
envprofile.Validate both refuse it
